Ask for {total} Armored Transports to carry the captured convicts back to the prison.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights and bring the convicts down.
You can fight up to 15 battles a day.
Harvest {total} Pineapples to celebrate a sweet victory.
Plant Pineapples in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
The trap was set and our quarry is in sight. Get those guns blazing; it's time to finish this thing!
Always a pleasure working with you, Commander. My prison cells have a few more occupants thanks to you!
Those pages are extremely valuable, Commander. Without them, I won't be able to complete my new Titan design. We can't afford to let them fall into the wrong hands!

The higher your game level, the better your reward! Players at levels 12 - 30 get the SpecOps Sombrero Carrier I; levels 31 - 50 get the SpecOps Sombrero Carrier II and levels 51+ get the SpecOps Sombrero Carrier III.
Without the missing plans, Seabolt's new Titan will never be finished. Help him recover them.
Commander, we have a problem! Some vital pages from the new Titan plans I've been drawing up are missing! We must recover them.
This is going to be uncomfortable. I hate to accuse anyone, but the plans went missing when {playerA,name} visited our Empire. Let's investigate.
string.variation: This is going to be uncomfortable. I hate to accuse anyone, but the plans went missing when {playerA,fem} visited our Empire. Let's investigate.
This is going to be uncomfortable. I hate to accuse anyone, but the plans went missing when {playerA,masc} visited our Empire. Let's investigate.

string.original: Get {total} Satellite Spy Photos of the suspect's Empire.
Ask Friend for Satellite Spy Photos.
Collect {total} Red Hearts to avoid arousing suspicion.
Visit your Neighbors and help them out, or repel invasions in your Neighbors' Empires.
Clear {total} Trees from neighboring Empires and listen for rumors.
Visit Neighbors' Empires and click on Trees to clear.
I have a feeling one of your neighbors is behind this.
Well done, but we still don't have much to go on. We're going to have to question {playerA,name}.
string.variation: Well done, but we still don't have much to go on. We're going to have to question {playerA,fem}.
Well done, but we still don't have much to go on. We're going to have to question {playerA,masc}.

string.original: It appears that {playerA,name} has learned of our investigation and has gone into hiding. Send out a search party, Commander. We need to find answers!
string.variation: It appears that {playerA,fem} has learned of our investigation and has gone into hiding. Send out a search party, Commander. We need to find answers!
It appears that {playerA,masc} has learned of our investigation and has gone into hiding. Send out a search party, Commander. We need to find answers!

string.original: Ask for {total} Rope Ladders to scale walls if you must.
Gather {total} {nrare} to bribe people for information.
Collect from your own Mines, harvest or pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
{playerA,name} is on to our game. This won't do.
string.variation: {playerA,fem} is on to our game. This won't do.
{playerA,masc} is on to our game. This won't do.

string.original: Good job, we found {playerA,name} holed up in a shady inn. Now, let's see if we can get some clarity on this whole thing.
string.variation: Good job, we found {playerA,fem} holed up in a shady inn. Now, let's see if we can get some clarity on this whole thing.
Good job, we found {playerA,masc} holed up in a shady inn. Now, let's see if we can get some clarity on this whole thing.

string.original: {playerA,name} is in our custody. It's time we got some answers. We must tackle this delicately, Commander. Our relationship with our allies is at stake.
string.variation: {playerA,fem} is in our custody. It's time we got some answers. We must tackle this delicately, Commander. Our relationship with our allies is at stake.
{playerA,masc} is in our custody. It's time we got some answers. We must tackle this delicately, Commander. Our relationship with our allies is at stake.

string.original: Earn {total} Black Hearts as a sign that you don't like being taken for a fool.
Earn Black Hearts by successfully invading and collecting from invaded Neighbors, or repelling invasions in your Empire.
Build {total} Power-Ups to scare the truth out of {playerA,name}.
string.variation: Build {total} Power-Ups to scare the truth out of {playerA,fem}.
Build {total} Power-Ups to scare the truth out of {playerA,masc}.

string.original: If you don't have the Power-Up Factory, you can build it. You will find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
Tread with caution, Commander. Our questions must be answered.
Blackmail always makes things interesting. It appears that Dirk Mollman is holding {playerA,name}'s family hostage and will release them only once he has the Titan plans in hand.
string.variation: Blackmail always makes things interesting. It appears that Dirk Mollman is holding {playerA,fem}'s family hostage and will release them only once he has the Titan plans in hand.
Blackmail always makes things interesting. It appears that Dirk Mollman is holding {playerA,masc}'s family hostage and will release them only once he has the Titan plans in hand.

string.original: {playerA,name} has pointed us to where Dirk's Titans are holding the hostages. This isn't going to be easy. It's vital that you get them out safely!
string.variation: {playerA,fem} has pointed us to where Dirk's Titans are holding the hostages. This isn't going to be easy. It's vital that you get them out safely!
{playerA,masc} has pointed us to where Dirk's Titans are holding the hostages. This isn't going to be easy. It's vital that you get them out safely!

string.original: Ask for {total} Candy Bars to soothe hostages. Chocolate makes everything better.
Fight the Titans holding {playerA,name}'s family hostage.
string.variation: Fight the Titans holding {playerA,fem}'s family hostage.
Fight the Titans holding {playerA,masc}'s family hostage.

string.original: Pick your units wisely in the fight. Using Titans of your own will give you an edge.
Deploy a Strike Team to assist you.
Deploy Strike Teams when repelling invasions on your Empire. Build them at the Strike Team HQ.
Thanks to {playerA,name}, we now know where to find the hostages.
string.variation: Thanks to {playerA,fem}, we now know where to find the hostages.
Thanks to {playerA,masc}, we now know where to find the hostages.

string.original: Excellent! {playerA,name}'s family is safe and sound. You made sure that no harm came to them. But I'm afraid that in the chaos of it all, Dirk escaped with the plans!
string.variation: Excellent! {playerA,fem}'s family is safe and sound. You made sure that no harm came to them. But I'm afraid that in the chaos of it all, Dirk escaped with the plans!
Excellent! {playerA,masc}'s family is safe and sound. You made sure that no harm came to them. But I'm afraid that in the chaos of it all, Dirk escaped with the plans!

string.original: One of the hostages overheard Dirk say he was going to sell the plans to B.F. Dealio. We've dealt with Dealio in the past. A little intimidation will go a long way in getting information out of him.
Collect {total} Brass Knuckles to intimidate Dealio with.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights as a sign of your superior strength.
You can fight up to 15 battles a day.
Harvest {total} Red Onions with which to make Dealio cry.
Plant Red Onions in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
It's time to play the 'bad cop' card!
Dealio claims that Dirk tried to sell him the plans, but he wanted much more than what Dealio was offering.

According to Dealio, Dirk knows he can't safely sell the plans anywhere else without arousing our suspicions. He's planning to lie low for a while in his most recent underground lair. Get ready, Commander. We're going under.
Collect {total} Trained Moles to be our eyes underground.
Build {total} Strike Teams to help you hunt for Dirk's lair.
If you haven't built a Strike Team HQ, you can find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
Invade your Neighbors and collect resources.
Dirk loves his tunnel hideouts. Lucky for us, we've got some friendly helpers underground.
Great work! I knew you'd find Dirk's hidey-hole in record time.

We've found the tunnel entrance to Dirk's lair but I don't think we should go down there. Dirk is notorious for his booby traps and we're not familiar with the tunnels. I say we draw him above ground.
Collect {total} Smoke Bombs to smoke Dirk out of his lair.
Win {total} World Domination fights to keep your skills sharp.
You can either attack people or take revenge on people who have attacked you, in World Domination battles.
Clone {total} Units in case you need backup.
You can clone units via the Espionage HQ. If you haven't built it yet, you will find it in your Inventory under the Buildings tab.
It's time to draw the Mollman out of his hole!
Here he comes! Quick, let's get him before he tries to escape!
Now that he's above ground, Dirk doesn't have an advantage over us. Bring him down, but steer clear of his drill. He isn't picky about where he sticks it!
Collect {total} Shipping Tubes to carry the plans safely back.
Fight the Titans who try to keep you from Dirk.
Using Titans of your own will give you an edge in battle.
Fight the last of Dirk's forces.
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
Get that thieving rat, Commander. Just watch out for his drill. That thing can get nasty!
We did it! Dirk has had quite a lesson drilled into him and I've got my precious plans back. I owe you one, Commander!
We don't know who the Duchess is after, nor how or when she plans to attack. Let's rally our resources and stop her!
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the SpecOps Bull Tank and SpecOps Anitron Fighter; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
The Duchess is back and plotting an assassination. Don't let her succeed!
Commander, one of my spies has uncovered some disturbing information. It appears that the Duchess is plotting a major assassination in your Empire!
The intel I received was encrypted and I only managed to decipher the first bit. We need to break the code and find out who the Duchess' target is.
Ask for {total} Code Breakers to decode the encrypted message.
Pay the Code Breakers {total} Coins. It's an expensive service they offer.
Spent Coins are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional Coins to get by first.
Clear {total} Trees from your neighbors' Empires. Find out if they know anything.
Visit Neighbors' Empires and click on Trees to clear.
Get your best Code Breakers on the job. This is one of the toughest I've seen!
It's lucky that we discovered this plot now, Commander. Things would have taken a disastrous turn if we hadn't!
The decoded message says that the Duchess' target is none other than Scarlett! We had better tighten our security. We should also set up Scarlett with some personal body guards.
Collect {total} Armed Body Guards for Scarlett's protection.
Ask Friend for Armed Body Guards.
Gather {total} Wood to strengthen your stronghold.
Wood can be produced in your Lumber Mills or can be obtained by clearing Trees.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Personal space is going to be just a dream for Scarlett until this is over!
Oh no! I've just received word that the Duchess had fed my spy false information. The real target is actually one of our allies! I hope we're not too late!
We must race to warn {playerA,name} but I'm afraid the Duchess may beat us to it. Look, Commander! There she is!
string.variation: We must race to warn {playerA,fem} but I'm afraid the Duchess may beat us to it. Look, Commander! There she is!
We must race to warn {playerA,masc} but I'm afraid the Duchess may beat us to it. Look, Commander! There she is!

string.original: Collect {total} Carrier Pigeons to send a warning to {playerA,name}.
string.variation: Collect {total} Carrier Pigeons to send a warning to {playerA,fem}.
Collect {total} Carrier Pigeons to send a warning to {playerA,masc}.

string.original: Use the Experimental healing ability {total} times in battle to prepare you to face the Duchess.
The Medivac Chopper, Hospital Ship and Army Ambulance offer these healing abilities.
Deploy {total} Infantry units to back you up.
Placing Infantry Units in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
This mistake could prove fatal to {playerA,name} if we're too late.
string.variation: This mistake could prove fatal to {playerA,fem} if we're too late.
This mistake could prove fatal to {playerA,masc} if we're too late.

string.original: We got lucky, Commander! We got here just in time to distract the Duchess. Her aim was ever so slightly off. {playerA,name} is injured, but alive thanks to you!
string.variation: We got lucky, Commander! We got here just in time to distract the Duchess. Her aim was ever so slightly off. {playerA,fem} is injured, but alive thanks to you!
We got lucky, Commander! We got here just in time to distract the Duchess. Her aim was ever so slightly off. {playerA,masc} is injured, but alive thanks to you!

string.original: The Duchess has rigged {playerA,name}'s car with a car bomb. Assemble a bomb squad. If we hurry, we might save the car!
string.variation: The Duchess has rigged {playerA,fem}'s car with a car bomb. Assemble a bomb squad. If we hurry, we might save the car!
The Duchess has rigged {playerA,masc}'s car with a car bomb. Assemble a bomb squad. If we hurry, we might save the car!

string.original: Ask for {total} Bomb Disposal Suits for the bomb squad.
Ask friends for Bomb Disposal Suits.
Gather {total} {nrare2}. The bomb squad needs the resources.
This ore can be produced in your Super Ore Mine, harvested or pillaged from Neighbors, or received in combat.
Complete {total} waves of Survival Mode to prepare you to meet the Duchess.
You don't have to complete all the waves at one go. You can come back later and try again.
Hurry, we can't let {playerA,name} get into that car!
string.variation: Hurry, we can't let {playerA,fem} get into that car!
Hurry, we can't let {playerA,masc} get into that car!

string.original: That was some explosion! We didn't make it in time, but the bomb off prematurely. Lucky for us, {playerA,name} was a few yards away and was only stunned.
string.variation: That was some explosion! We didn't make it in time, but the bomb off prematurely. Lucky for us, {playerA,fem} was a few yards away and was only stunned.
That was some explosion! We didn't make it in time, but the bomb off prematurely. Lucky for us, {playerA,masc} was a few yards away and was only stunned.

string.original: Don't rest easy yet, Commander. The Duchess isn't one to give up without a fight. She is bound to attempt the botched assassination again. We must stop her. Let's start by blowing up her arsenal...
Ask for {total} Remote Detonators to destroy the Duchess' arsenal.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights and break through the Duchess' defenses.
You can fight up to 15 battles a day.
Win {total} World Domination battles and bring the Duchess down.
You can either attack people or take revenge on people who have attacked you, in World Domination battles.
I've had enough of playing defense. It's time to get aggressive!
She was formidable, but you stood your ground. Well done, Commander. Victory tastes sweet indeed!

The Duchess isn't going to like the new bracelets on her wrists, but that isn't our concern. {playerA,name} is. Let's arrange for some therapy for our ally's PTSD. An assassination attempt can be traumatic...
string.variation: The Duchess isn't going to like the new bracelets on her wrists, but that isn't our concern. {playerA,fem} is. Let's arrange for some therapy for our ally's PTSD. An assassination attempt can be traumatic...

The Duchess isn't going to like the new bracelets on her wrists, but that isn't our concern. {playerA,masc} is. Let's arrange for some therapy for our ally's PTSD. An assassination attempt can be traumatic...

string.original: Ask for {total} Self-Help Audiotapes to assist in {playerA,name}'s recovery.
string.variation: Ask for {total} Self-Help Audiotapes to assist in {playerA,fem}'s recovery.
Ask for {total} Self-Help Audiotapes to assist in {playerA,masc}'s recovery.

string.original: Build {total} Mind Control Strike Teams. No one said therapy's easy.
If you haven't built a Strike Team HQ, you can find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
Harvest {total} Pineapples. Pineapple jam - apparently better than anti-anxiety pills.
Plant Pineapples in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
Slap those 'cuffs on her, Commander! And let's see what we can do to ease {playerA,name}'s trauma.
string.variation: Slap those 'cuffs on her, Commander! And let's see what we can do to ease {playerA,fem}'s trauma.
Slap those 'cuffs on her, Commander! And let's see what we can do to ease {playerA,masc}'s trauma.

string.original: And it's done! The Duchess is safely in our custody and {playerA,name} is on the fast road to recovery.
string.variation: And it's done! The Duchess is safely in our custody and {playerA,fem} is on the fast road to recovery.
And it's done! The Duchess is safely in our custody and {playerA,masc} is on the fast road to recovery.

string.original: It's as bad as we expected. You're the Duchess' target, Commander. I'd ask you to stay out of this but I think I already know your answer. For now, let's make the Empire a little safer for you.
Collect {total} Bulletproof Screens for our Government buildings.
Build an Ambush Strike Team to station around your buildings.
If you haven't built a Strike Team HQ, you can find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
Gather {total} Oil to keep your units fueled and ready for action.
Collect from your own Wells or Neighbors' Wells, pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
This is a disturbing development but you can't let it slow you down. Our first step is to set up the necessary safety measures.
Good work! We've taken a lot of precautions to make the Empire as safe as possible but there's no telling where the Duchess will break through our defenses.

With the Duchess, the only way to get the upper hand is to find her before she comes for us. I bet we can trace her location if we do some credit card checks. The Duchess is known to be a little credit-happy.
Collect{total} Credit Trackers to monitor the Duchess' credit activity.
Revive your neighbors' Crops {total} times. They'll be happy to help you when you need it.
Click on withered Crops in your Neighbors' Empires to revive them.
Pillage {total} times to keep your battle skills sharp.
Invade your Neighbors and collect resources.
The Duchess can't resist the lure of that shiny piece of plastic!
I knew that would work! Sure enough, a slew of credit purchases led us straight to her.

Since you're her target, it's a good idea to take some extra precautions. Set yourself up with a host of decoy dummies around you in addition to your personal guard.The Duchess won't be able to get a clear shot!
Ask for {total} Decoy Dummies to surround yourself with.
Clone {total} Units using the spy, Smithies. Ready backup can be a lifesaver.
You can clone units via the Espionage HQ. If you haven't built it yet, you will find it in your Inventory under the Buildings tab.
Collect {total} Element Z. It's sure to come in handy.
Build the Element Z Collider or Element Z Refinery to harvest Element Z. You can also receive this resource as a gift from friends.
Keep yourself surrounded at all times, Commander. If you don't have enough men, we can fix that.
Excellent! I'd like to see the Duchess try and make that shot now!

I know the arms dealer who supplies the Duchess; he isn't the most morally upright citizen. I also know that he has a thing for antiques. We can bribe him to replace the bullets he sells her with blanks.
Ask for {total} Antique Weapons to bribe the dealer with.
Offer {total} Oil to the arms dealer.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Use the Experimental Area Barrage ability {total} times in battle to intimidate the arms dealer.
The Cold War Interceptor, Barrage Truck and Sea Shadow offer this ability.
You're not above a little bribery, are you?
That was smooth, Commander! You really know how to play the bribery game. I don't know whether to be impressed or worried.
I've been hit! The Duchess caught on to us and took a cheap shot at me in a fit of fury. But it's only a flesh wound...It's up to you now. Bring her down!
Ask for {total} First Aid Kits to tend Steele's wound.
Ask friends for First Aid Kits.
You can use any Units when fighting Land Units.
Fight the Duchess and her forces.
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
Ugh, women! So fickle. Just when you think she's coming for you...
You did it! That was some defeat, Commander. Her anger made her reckless... I knew I didn't get shot for nothing!
We must hurry and set up our mining rig over the mineral deposit. I have a feeling we're not the only ones trying to make the most of this resource!
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the SpecOps Oton Battleship and SpecOps Armen Copter; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
Our deep sea mining rig is under a Dark Alliance threat!
Commander, There's a seam of rare earth minerals at the bottom of the sea, a few miles off the coast of our Empire. This could be a very valuable resource for us. Let's get mining!

Our first job is to pinpoint the exact location of this mineral deposit. Once we're sure of the spot, we can start making preparations to set up a deep sea mining rig. We'll be mining minerals in no time!
Ask for {total} Sea Cranes to set up the rig.
Clear {total} Trees in neighboring Empires. Wood is necessary for building.
Visit Neighbors' Empires and click on Trees to clear.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
My information didn't come with a handy 'X' to mark the spot. Find it so that we can set up!
All set, Commander? Let's head out to sea!

I knew it couldn't be this easy. We've got problems, Commander. It looks like Captain Krunsch beat us to it! He's setting up a rig of his own. These are technically still our waters so let's get him out!
Collect {total} Grappling Hooks to climb onto Krunsch's ship.
Invade one of your neighbors... we suspect that they're aiding Krunsch.
Find this Ally on your Neighbor Bar.
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
Krunsch and his ships are encroaching on our mineral deposit! Kick 'em out of there!
Krunsch sure beat a hasty retreat! It was almost suspicious, but we'll take our victories where we get them.
Krunsch may have retreated, but I know that he's just rallying his resources to strike again. In the meantime, that fight led to an oil spill that simply must be cleaned up!
Collect {total} Oil Skimmers to clean up the oil spill.
Deploy {total} Gunboats to patrol the area while you work.
Placing Gunboats in your Empire is deployment. They are built in your Shipyard.
Build {total} Power-Ups to boost your progress.
If you don't have the Power-Up Factory, you can build it. You will find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
Somebody was careless during that last fight. Let's clean up this oily mess.
Good job. We're on shaky ground with this deep sea mining process as it is. We must be responsible for all the environmental repercussions.

I can see why Krunsch retreated in such a hurry. The skies have opened up... there's a storm upon us, Commander! And it looks like a bad one. We won't make it back to our Empire in time. We'll just have to weather it as best as we can.
Ask for {total} Drift Anchors to secure your Ships.
Complete {total} waves of Survival Mode. Stand your ground against the elements!
You don't have to complete all the waves at one go. You can come back later and try again.
Expand your Naval Depot once. You'll soon be grateful for the extra space.
Upgrading lets you add more space to the Depot.
Hold fast, Commander. We're facing rough seas!
You did it! It was touch and go for a bit there, but the skies have cleared now. Let's get back to business.

Now that everything's clear, let's head down to the rare earth mineral deposit. Be warned, Commander, there are other dangers that lurk in the deep! I have heard dreadful stories of a giant squid in these waters...
Ask for {total} Giant Squid Repellents to keep us safe below.
Ask Friends for Giant Squid Repellents.
Deploy {total} Battleships in case Krunsch shows up again.
Placing Battleships in your Empire is deployment. They are built in your Shipyard.
Fend off the monsters of the sea!
Pick your units wisely in this fight.
The depths are dark and full of terrors.
Do you know, I actually believed we wouldn't even catch a glimpse of the squid! You were brave down there, but that clash has exhausted your oxygen supply. Replenish and start again.
It's time to finish setting up our rig on the seabed. We lost some valuable time though... Krunsch's divers have returned.
Ask for {total} Air Compressors to replenish your dive tanks.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights and defeat all the divers.
You can fight up to 15 battles a day.
Win {total} Domination battles. Show the Captain who's boss!
You can either attack people or take revenge on people who have attacked you, in World Domination battles.
We have some unwelcome company again.
Nicely done! Krunsch would have to be clinically unbalanced to try and steal a piece of this mineral deposit again.
Mobilize your divers and send them down to oversee the installation of our deep sea mining rig on the seabed.
Collect {total} Dive Permits so that you can navigate the deep.
Use {total} Oil to power the boats that carry your divers out to sea.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Build {total} Sea Units to maintain steady traffic to and from the rig.
Sea Units can be built in your Shipyards.
Divers make for really good scouts.
Good work Commander. Now we sit back and wait for news from our divers.

Our divers returned to report that some Dark Alliance divers were already at the mineral seam. It looked like Captain Krunsch's work. This will be easier if we work with him. Make a deal with him to share resources.
Collect {total} Cabin Boys to share the workload on both rigs.
Earn {total} Red Hearts to seal the deal.
Visit your Neighbors and help them out, or repel invasions in your Neighbors' Empires.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
The Captain could make things very difficult for us. Let's see if we can work with him instead.
This seems to be going well. Play nice together now!
Krunsch's men double crossed us! They stole our diving equipment and made their way down to the ocean floor to dismantle our rig. Follow them down!
Ask for {total} Diving Helmets to replace the ones you lost.
Pillage {total} times to show that you mean business.
Invade your Neighbors and collect resources.
Pick your units wisely in this fight.
I should have seen this one coming. Apologies, Commander. You're going to have to fix this.
Krunsch's men had an unfair advantage over us. Worry not, Commander. Reinforcements are on their way.
I have bad news... A freak accident led to a misunderstanding between your men and Krunsch's. They think we've double crossed them. Defend yourself, quick!
Ask for {total} Work Logs to prove the accident wasn't your fault.
Use {total} Power-Ups to give you an edge.
Use Power-Ups in battle to fight more effectively. Power-Ups are won in Battle Blitz or Dominance victories or built in your Power-Up Factory.
Pick your units wisely in this fight.
I half suspect that Krunsch was looking for an excuse to throw this deal.
You won this round... but this is far from over.
Krunsch intends to claim sole custody of the resources mined from that deposit. It's time to wipe the area of all trace of him. I've had enough of his shenanigans!
Ask for {total} Cannon Ramrods to load the cannons and sink Krunsch's ships.
Win {total} Domination Battles and put an end to Krunsch's mischief.
You can either attack people or take revenge on people who have attacked you, in World Domination battles.
Add {total} Allies to help you defeat Captain Krunsch.
Add more neighbors through your Neighbor Bar. Neighbors will help you progress faster!
Let's send the good Captain down with his ship. Although, knowing Krunsch, he'll abandon ship long before it sinks.
You did good, Commander! Those resources are now ours to mine freely.
We must find a way to put an end to Soren's tyranny, Commander, and not just for the sake of the people of Vonne. As long as Soren rules, all the Empires will face a very real threat of war.

The higher your game level, the better your reward! Players at levels 12 - 30 get the SpecOps Anubis Infantry I; levels 31 - 50 get the SpecOps Anubis Infantry II and levels 51+ get the SpecOps Anubis Infantry III.
A dictator raises his ugly head. Put an end to the tyranny!
War is brewing in the country of Vonne and its dictator, Soren, is at the heart of it all. This situation is more volatile that we previously thought. We must take drastic measures to control it.
Our best men are away on an important mission with Steele. I suggest that you assemble a new squad with the men we have at hand. Start training them, Commander.
Get {total} Bootcamp Cadences to get your men into their rhythm faster.
Use {total} Oil to get some rusty rifles ready for the training exercises.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Pick your units wisely in this fight.
You'll just have to make do, Commander. You can't always have the best.
Oh no, with our best men gone; this squad doesn't have a hope of acquiring the level of skill we need to take Soren down.
Now, hear me out, Commander. As one of the best hit squads around, the Graves girls may be just what we need to whip our team into shape on short notice... for a price, of course.
Ask for {total} Lawyers to draw up a legal contract with the girls.
Give {total} Coins to the girls as part of a down payment for their services.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Complete an upgrade for your Army Depot. You'll need the space for your new units.
Upgrading lets you add more space to the Depot.
Legal counsel is always handy when dealing with the Graves girls.
Hmm, only Gina Graves accepted our deal. Tina is apparently away "on a job." But it matters not. Gina should do just fine.

It seems that Gina has been having a little too much fun with our men. All her toying and flirting has caused some rifts among them. Knock some sense into them, Commander. And make sure Gina gets her act together.
Collect {total} Disciplinary Rulers. Your men are behaving like children.
Deploy {total} Soldiers to make sure the squad gets back in line.
Placing soldiers in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
Complete {total} waves in Survival Mode with your men.
You don't have to complete all the waves at one go. You can come back later and try again.
Honestly, why are you even surprised? I knew Gina would pull something like this. She IS a Graves!
It's a good thing you managed to straighten out your squad, Commander. we don't have all the time in the world to get this job done.
Good news! It looks like this rag-tag bunch of men might actually be ready for their mission! Help Gina put them through one last training exercise to see if I'm right.
Ask for {total} Shooting Targets for the training exercise.
Deal {total} damage using Infantry Units and sharpen your squad's skills.
Use Infantry Units to fight battles and deal damage. Infantry Units can be built in your Barracks.
Pick your units wisely in this fight.
It's time to see if Gina managed to do more than just tease your men.
Yes! Gina did it! You know, I hate to admit it, but I'm impressed with her work. She did a darned good job of whipping our men into shape. They're as ready as they'll ever be.
Let's get this operation on the road, Commander. We attack Soren's mansion before dawn.
Collect {total} Mission Maps for your squad.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights. Things are starting to heat up!
You can fight up to 15 battles a day.
Spend {total} Coins to get this mission started.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Your men are a tad overenthusiastic. Order them to move quietly!
Our men were ambushed! Soren was expecting them; we only just got out in time. But here's what's interesting... one of them spotted Gina lounging in Soren's office!

It just had to be too easy! Knowing the girls as we do, I'm pretty sure it was Tina Graves that our man spotted. They must have been in contact this entire time! Maybe they hoped for a double payout? This complicates things.
Collect {total} Connection Charts to plot out all the possible obstacles we could now face.
Build {total} Mind Control Strike Teams to get into the Graves girls' heads.
If you haven't built a Strike Team HQ, you can find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
Build {total} Power-Ups to prepare for an imminent battle.
If you don't have the Power-Up Factory, you can build it. You will find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
I should have known. You can never trust a Graves!
Gina's betrayal was a huge spanner in the works but I think we can still salvage this mission. Those girls are due for a spanking!

We have a better chance of defeating the girls if we take them down one at a time. Gina doesn't yet know that we spotted Tina and figured out their game. She'll be back to collect her training fee. Let's set up a little welcome for her.
Collect {total} Booby Traps to set out for Gina.
This ore can be produced in your Super Ore Mine, harvested or pillaged from Neighbors, or received in combat.
Deal {total} damage to Land Units to make Gina think we're just preparing for round 2.
Stronger Units will deal greater damage in battle.
She doesn't know that we know what she knows. You know?
Good work, Commander! We've got the first Graves!

It's time for a face-off with Gina's crazy twin. This time, I'm coming with you. I've used a cast of Gina's face to get some latex masks fashioned. If Tina's expecting her sister at Soren's mansion, we can't disappoint her! Let's get two birds with this stone.
Collect {total} Mask Sculptors to make masks of Gina's face for our disguise.
Deal {total} damage using Air Units. We're going in from the skies!
Use Air Units to fight battles and deal damage. Air Units can be built in your Hangar.
Win {total} World Domination fights. Time to bring Tina and Soren down!
You can either attack people or take revenge on people who have attacked you, in World Domination battles.
You don't have to be stingy with your units; this is a Graves girl after all.
Success! I must say, impersonating a Graves girl was way more fun than I thought it would be! Tina's in our custody and so is Soren. Excellent work, Commander!
Daha zor seviyeler sana daha büyük ödüller kazandırır. Akıllıca seç, çünkü başladıktan sonra bu seviyeyi değiştiremezsin.

If you think we're horsing around, think again! When a prince, who always gets his way, finds his champion horse missing and you're hosting the race it was to win, it could mean war! With no ransom note, we have no idea what's involved!
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the SpecOps Behemoth Artillery and SpecOps Ankit UUV Patrol Boat; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
Find a missing champion horse in time for the International Cup! Before the prince who owns it becomes a royal pain!
The cup favorite for the multi-nation derby we're hosting is gone! The angry owner is a spoilt prince! He's threatening to do some serious damage if we don't find his horse.
You earned 5x SpecOps Ankit UUV Patrol Boat!

We're facing accusations of sabotaging the race! Get an investigative team together. Brief them and impress on them the consequences of not finding the horse, Silver Bullet. His owner is turning up the heat!
Ask for {total} Disposable Cellphones to keep your team connected.
Donate {total} Wood to other horse owners to build secure pens.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Fight another minor trouble-making nation that's trying to impress the prince, by attacking you.
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
This is no time to horse around, Commander. Tensions are running high today!
Is your team ready? I hope they understand how serious this situation is. This isn't just any horse that's gone missing...

Before we expand our search, we have to make sure that Silver Bullet isn't stashed under our noses. Set up road blocks in a 20 mile radius around the course and check all vehicles that look large enough to hold a horse.
Collect {total} Spiked Roadblocks to set up on your streets.
Deploy {total} Land Units in case the horse's owner attacks!
Placing Land Units in your Empire is deployment. Land Units are built in your Barracks.
A radical group in the Prince's Empire saw a chance to cause havoc. Fight them and win.
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
One too many villains have pulled fast ones on us by hiding in plain sight. That's not going to happen this time!
All done? No kidnapped horse in sight? All right, let's expand our investigation.
Let's get our people involved! Put out news broadcasts with pictures of Silver Bullet, pictures of any suspects and a reward notice for any information.
Collect {total} Reward Posters to motivate the public to help.
Donate {total} Oil to fuel your search teams' vehicles.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Build {total} Strike Team(s) in preparation for a horse rescue mission.
If you haven't built a Strike Team HQ, you can find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
An extra mile for an extra buck. That's the way the world works!
Our phones are ringing off the hook! A lot of the calls coming in are rubbish but we've already picked up a couple of potential leads. Good work!
Our best sources of intel have often been disreputable ones. Incentivize our underworld informants. Promise to wipe their slates clean if they can give you any information on a horse being moved.
Ask for {total} Criminal Records to be wiped clean.
Donate {total} Coins to a local business owned by the Mafia.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Get {total} Element Z, as a battle resource back-up.
Build the Element Z Collider or Element Z Refinery to harvest Element Z. You can also receive this resource as a gift from friends.
The seedy miscreants in your Empire often hold a wealth of information... if you know whom to ask!
Very smooth, Commander! One of your informants came forward with some interesting information. Let's see if it checks out!
Our source claims that the culprit is a disgruntled jockey who was banned from racing, due to charges of malpractice. I have word on where he might be hiding out. Let's head over there.
Ask for {total} Snapshots of the suspect so that your men will recognize him.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights as practice for any upcoming fights.
You can fight up to 15 battles a day.
Fight a few goons who are protecting the culprit.
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
These jockeys. So quick to anger!
Our little man had a band of tough goons to protect him. Unfortunately for us, he escaped while you were fighting them.

Commander, we have sights on our runaway horse-napper! He's not very stable though. From the way he's been treating the horse, I can tell he isn't above hurting it if we get too close. Put those guns down; it's time to negotiate.
Ask for {total} Mediators to help you talk to the culprit.
Deploy {total} Grunt Soldiers because this mission is heating up.
Placing Grunt Soldiers in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
Harvest {total} Red Onions for soup. Mediators work best on full stomachs.
Plant Red Onions in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
I'll let you in on a little secret: a little sweet-talking can break even the most hardened of criminals.
Excellent work, Commander! The jockey gave himself up in exchange for a more lenient sentence. Silver Bullet is back with his owner! Peace reigns again!

Mobilize that team you assembled. We're going to send them out in search of information. They have permission to cross borders if they have to. Tell them to be careful though. Getting caught could make things even more awkward.
Collect {total} Fake Passports for your spies in case they need them.
Build {total} Bombers in case more fighting breaks out.
Bombers can be built in your Hangar.
Gather {total} {rare} to make guns, to supply your investigators.
Collect from your own Mines, harvest or pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
I dislike resorting to underhanded methods, but these are desperate times...
As I suspected, an enemy nation had Silver Bullet kidnapped! Their plan of course was to get you in the bad books of the owner - a Prince known for his temper!
One of our spies has brought back intel about a deserted warehouse near the docks that was hired by an anonymous source. It's the perfect place to hide a stolen horse. Find the warehouse!
Collect {total} Area Images of the dock.
Build {total} Power-Ups to be better prepared.
If you don't have the Power-Up Factory, you can build it. You will find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
Complete {total} waves in Survival Mode, to test your battle reflexes.
You don't have to complete all the waves at one go. You can come back later and try again.
The dock that the spy spoke about has several warehouses within a 5 mile radius. Scour them all!
You heard neighing? That must be it, Commander! You found the warehouse!

This is the one! Station your men around the targeted warehouse. But remember, shooting inside will certainly harm the horse. We cannot afford to let anything happen to it. You must lure the villains out instead.
Ask for {total} Flashbangs to lure the villains outside the warehouse.
Use {total} Power-Ups in battle to get an advantage.
Use Power-Ups in battle to fight more effectively. Power-Ups are won in Battle Blitz or Dominance victories or built in your Power-Up Factory.
Earn {total} Black Hearts because you're not above a little distraction deception.
Earn Black Hearts by successfully invading and collecting from invaded Neighbors, or repelling invasions in your Empire.
Bright lights and loud noises - always good methods to grab attention!
It worked like a charm! Here they come... go get them, Commander!

We were too late! The warehouse was empty by the time we got there. I think the idea was to ship Silver Bullet out in a cargo container. Race to the docks and intercept them! We need to find the right container and we're running out of time.
Ask for {total} Bloodhounds to help you find the right container with the horse.
Use {total} Experimental Abilities in battle, just to show off a little.
Experimental Units can be built in the Experimental Shipyard, Experimental Barracks and Experimental Hangar. The 'Use Element Z' button below the battle stage activates this ability.
Deploy {total} Soldiers to be stationed around the docks.
Placing Soldiers in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
No container wall is too thick for a bloodhound's nose!
Excellent! You recovered the champion horse! The villains may have escaped but our primary concern is returning the horse to its owners.

The races are back on! Stay on your guard, the villains aren't about to give up just yet. Set up snipers at strategic locations around the course. The enemy is desperate, now that they've been caught. Here they come!
Ask for {total} Scout Scopes for your snipers on the watch.
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
Get {total} Domination War Chests to prove that you rule!
You'll get one War Chest with every Domination battle that you win.
When thwarted, villains always come back for that final run.
You caught the villains and the Prince has withdrawn his threat of war. What's more, the races were a grand success in spite of all this drama! You did it, Commander!

The psychopath has threatened that if we lose, his game will ultimately lead us to war with Bentris, a neighboring nation. He has asked for 100 million dollars as ransom in order to abort all the disasters. We can't let this happen!
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the SpecOps Raccoon Copter and SpecOps Grimm D7 Carrier; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
Will you be just a puppet in a madman's dance of disaster?

I received an anonymous call regarding a series of disasters set to occur in our Empire. The caller said that they will begin on his command but we will be given clues an hour before each starts. It's a dangerous game...but play, we must!
You earned 5x SpecOps Grimm D7 Carrier!

Let's start with our only clue: Bentris, the nation apparently on the brink of war with us. We must know of any possibilities that could provoke this kind of trouble. Invite the nation's leader to your Empire for a diplomatic discussion.
Ask for {total} Cups of Coffee so that the suspect doesn't suspect anything.
Ask Friends for Cups of Coffee.
Take out his personal bodyguards, just to make sure they don't attack.
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
Earn {total} Red Hearts as a gesture of goodwill to your Neighbors.
Visit your Neighbors and help them out, or repel invasions in your Neighbors' Empires.
Coffee: the great unifier and potential spiller of secrets.
Well, you grilled him as much as you could without outright demanding answers. It looks like he really knows nothing about our mystery caller and his threats...
We have very little to go on, Commander. We must make contact. We need a time extension. Tell the madman we can't arrange for that kind of money in such a short time span.
Collect and send him {total} Bottles of Wine to soften him up to our request.
Ask Friends for Bottles of Wine.
Give {total} Wood to Real Estate tycoons for construction, so they'll help raise funds if needed.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Build a Strike Team to deal with any disaster, if the madman grants no extension.
If you haven't built a Strike Team HQ, you can find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
A lot can be done with an extra 24 hours.
It could just be the wine talking, but our caller has agreed to a 24-hour extension. Let's work fast!

The villain must not suspect that you're trying to track him down! I've organized several crack teams of intelligence agents to interrogate members of the underworld on the sly. Who knows what we'll be able to squeeze out of them?
Collect {total} Foldable Knives to intimidate members of the underworld.
Pillage {total} times to demonstrate that messing with you is not a good idea.
Invade your Neighbors and collect resources.
Destroy {total} Land Units as you go on your information collection rampage.
Land Units can be destroyed in battles, including Survival Mode, World Domination and Battle Blitz.
It's crazy; those underworld guys always seem to know what's going on!
Hmmm, now this is interesting...our agents have unearthed some curious information.

Let's set our police force in motion. They have their own network of confidential informants within the criminal circles. We can pull them in to find out if they've heard of anything that's going down.
Ask for {total} C.I. Phonebooks to call in the confidential informants.
Earn {total} Black Hearts to show off your superior power.
Earn Black Hearts by successfully invading and collecting from invaded Neighbors, or repelling invasions in your Empire.
Collect {total} {nrare4} because it pays to be prepared.
This ore can be produced in your Super Ore Mine, harvested or pillaged from Neighbors, or received in combat.
Be careful not to compromise the informants when you meet them. They need to maintain their criminal contacts to be of use.
Our informants have discovered a trail of evidence that leads to a local crime lord. This whole thing is just getting murkier the deeper we dig! Let's see if we're right...
Ask for {total} Night Vision Binoculars to help us set up an after-dark ambush.
Ask Friends for Night Vision Binoculars.
Deal {total} damage using Air Units, to sharpen your pilots' skills, just in case.
Use Air Units to fight battles and deal damage. Air Units can be built in your Hangar.
Fight the crime lord and win!
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
This crime lord won't be expecting us. Use the cover of the night and the element of surprise to your advantage.
This investigation has come full circle, Commander! The crime lord caved and revealed that the nation leader we first met with was behind it all along!
It's time to go straight to the heart of this mess. Use force to teach that conniving nation leader a lesson he'll never forget. The only ransom he will receive is a big dent in his armed forces!
Ask for {total} Ammo Belts to arm your troops with.
Win {total} World Domination fights as practice for the upcoming battle.
You can either attack people or take revenge on people who have attacked you, in World Domination battles.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights to practice even more.
You can fight up to 15 battles a day.
Our enemy is bringing out the big guns so you'd better do the same!
Impressive work, Commander! Here's to the end of this madness.

We just received our first clue, Commander. And of course, it's in the form of a riddle. I tell you, these people watch too many movies. I have a bad feeling that it relates to a bomb somewhere. Let's get cracking!
Collect {total} Cryptographers to unravel the riddle.
Harvest {total} Corn to make a meal for the hardworking investigators.
Plant Corn in your Farms and wait for it to grow before harvesting.
Gather {total} {rare} because metal is always a useful resource to have.
Collect from your own Mines, harvest or pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
The madman fancies himself a riddler. Solve it quick! It will only spell disaster if you don't.
That was quick work, Commander! That bomb blast was very narrowly averted. Let's see what this madman's next move is.

Our 'friendly, neighborhood' psychopath didn't bank on us thwarting his first disaster. He didn't bother with his rules and riddles this time. Masked gunmen are terrorizing the area surrounding your World Embassy!
Collect {total} sets of Riot Gear for your men.
Complete {total} waves in Survival Mode to remind your men that you're great survivors!
You don't have to complete all the waves at one go. You can come back later and try again.
Use {total} Strike Teams to handle the masked gunmen.
Deploy Strike Teams when repelling invasions in your Empire. Build them at the Strike Team HQ.
So much for the psycho's great game. Nobody plays by the rules anymore.
Your quick decisions on the field saved the World Embassy! But I fear that the hard part is only beginning...

The psychopath has made another move: this time his target is a nuclear plant in the Empire. He has taken some of the workers hostage! It's up to you to secretly infiltrate the facility and free it of his hold.
Ask for {total} NBC Suits for radiation protection.
Use {total} Power-Ups in battle, because now you need the upper hand.
Use Power-Ups in battle to fight more effectively. Power-Ups are won in Battle Blitz or Dominance victories or built in your Power-Up Factory.
Build {total} Soldiers to increase your force against this unseen enemy.
Soldiers can be built in your Army Barracks.
I'm not certain how you managed it, but you did it! The nuclear plant is back in our possession! Those hostages couldn't be more grateful.

The madman has struck again! The power supply across your subway lines has been cut, causing complete chaos underground! You need to restore the power and evacuate the people before panic takes over completely.
Ask for {total} Heavy Duty Generators to supply power to the subway.
Ask Friends for Heavy Duty Generators.
Harvest {total} Element Z as a back-up war resource.
Build the Element Z Collider or Element Z Refinery to harvest Element Z. You can also receive this resource as a gift from friends.
Repel {total} invasions from Neighboring Empires to gain some confidence.
Visit your Friends' Empires to help repel invaders.
The madman is trying to slow you down and split your resources. Don't let him get the better of you!
You were cool under fire! Good thing too, or we would have had a much harder job controlling the growing panic among the passengers! Thanks to you, the subway is functioning again.

The psychopath seized control of our Air Traffic Control Rooms and caused a mid-air collision of two aircrafts! Voyeur of destruction that he is, he's still in there, watching the damage unfold. We finally have him in our sights. Move in!
Ask for {total} Straitjackets. He's going to be locked up for a long time!
Fight the psychopath's security goons and win.
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
Deploy {total} Field Artillery Units to arm the high-security asylum guards.
Placing Field Artillery Units in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
This guy always caused his mischief and scampered. Until now!
The madman's voyeuristic tendencies proved to be his undoing! Good job, Commander. I'm glad this whole thing is finally over!

The new batch of microchips came from my scientist friends in Veirra. They're the absolute latest in technology! But the Titans that have the new embedded chips haven't been functioning right during my tests...
You earned x5 SpecOps Platana Battleship!
The higher your game level, the better your reward! Players at levels 12 - 30 get version I of the SpecOps Platana Battleship; levels 31 - 50 get version II and levels 51+ get version III.
Hard-to-control Titans can only mean one thing: imminent disaster!
I'd ordered a new batch of specially engineered microchips to embed in a new batch of Titans. But something isn't right...
I've asked the team of scientists who worked on the microchips to visit my lab and help me out. Will you escort them here from the cold mountains of Veirra?
Amass {total} Bun Warmers to protect the scientists' rear flanks.
Collect from {total} Government Structures to finance the scientists' visit.
Click on Government Structures in your Empire, to collect.
Earn {total} Red Hearts to prove that you're a generous host.
Visit your Neighbors and help them out, or repel invasions in your Neighbors' Empires.
See that no harm comes to them as you travel. They rarely leave their lab in Veirra. This is a huge honor.
The Veirran scientists had much to say about what sounded like an uneventful journey. Thanks for treating them well, Commander!
The Veirran scientists did some tests and the Titans are ready to be taken out on a test run. Commander, look out! The Titans are going rogue on us! They're destroying my lab!
Ask for {total} Reassuring Pats to calm the scientists down while we handle the Titans.
Collect {total} {nrare2} because the scientists need it for their tests.
This ore can be produced in your Super Ore Mine, harvested or pillaged from Neighbors, or received in combat.
Harvest {total} Element Z, because rogue Titans will certainly lead to Titan fights.
Build the Element Z Collider or Element Z Refinery to harvest Element Z. You can also receive this resource as a gift from friends.
I can't understand why this is happening! We must save the lab, Commander. Fight them!
You managed to force the Titans out of the lab but there was no way to prevent the damage they caused in the Empire. We were unprepared for this calamity, Commander.

We need to do some emergency damage control! The Titans went on a rampage over a part of the Empire, before departing to some unknown destination. Before we go after them, we must embark on relief missions for your citizens.
Get {total} Supply Drops for the stricken citizens.
Ask Friends for Supply Drops. You can also add more Neighbors through the World Parliament.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Harvest {total} Corn, to feed the frightened refugees.
Plant Corn in your Farms and wait for it to grow before harvesting.
Your people need you, Commander. Our runaway Titans can wait.
Now that your citizens are taken care of, we have to deal with the rogue Titans who escaped from the Empire.

The scientists insist that certain circuits in those corrupted chips were tampered with AFTER they shipped them. Someone must have switched the packages... Aaaah, there's another one of those Titans! Defend yourself!
Ask for {total} Circuit Testers for the Veirran scientists to test their theory.
Ask Friends for Circuit Testers. You can also add more Neighbors through the World Parliament.
Build {total} Land Units as part of your defense against the Titan.
Land Units can be built in your Army Barracks.
Pick your units wisely in the fight. Using Titans of your own will give you an edge.
My Veirran friends suspect foul play and I'm inclined to believe them.
We were better prepared for that attack this time. Now, follow that retreating Titan!

The Titan led us to a camp in a valley - it's a Dark Alliance camp led by Beau LeChomp! Somehow I'm never surprised to find the DA behind everything. Let's send a scout down into the camp and see what intel he brings back.
Collect {total} Microphone Bugs for our scout to plant around the camp.
Have a Titan Lab in your Empire. It always makes sense to build your own Titan.
If you haven't already placed the Titan Lab, you will find it in your Inventory, under the Buildings tab.
Build {total} Power-Ups. You must be prepared, when fighting Titans is involved.
If you don't have the Power-Up Factory, you can build it. You will find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
It's been a while since we last saw Beau. I must say he hasn't gotten any easier on the eyes...
Our scout discovered that LeChomp was the one who switched the microchip package the Veirrans sent, with a DA-tampered one. He now controls our Titans!
My Veirran buddies have been hard at work fixing up a new batch of microchips! You're going to have to sneak into the camp to try and replace the microchips in our Titans.
Collect {total} Sneak Suits to help us move in with stealth.
Ask Friends for Sneak Suits. You can also add more Neighbors through the World Parliament.
Build {total} Titan Atlas Heads to better equip your Titans, when you get them back.
An Atlas Head is a primary Titan Part that you can build in the Titan Lab.
Pillage {total} times to gather resources you need to build your own Titan.
Invade your Neighbors and collect resources.
Out with the old, in with the new. That's the plan!
Foiled! LeChomp caught on to our plan and set his Titans on us. It's a good thing you beat a hasty retreat when you did! Let's regroup and try something else.

It might be easier to tackle this situation on home ground. If we steal LeChomp's Element Z supplies and head back to our Empire, he'll be forced to follow us and get them back if he wants to replenish his almost run-down Titans.
Collect {total} Inert Containers to transport the stolen Element Z.
Donate {total} Titan Platings to the Vierrans to thank them for their help.
Spent resources are gone permanently, so make sure you have enough additional resources to get by first.
Deploy {total} Vintage Carriers in case LeChomp tries to approach by sea.
Placing Vintage Carriers in your Empire is deployment. Vintage Carriers are built in your Shipyard.
Element Z: every Titan's weakness. Let's cut off LeChomp's supply!
Yes! We've got LeChomp's entire supply of Element Z! It's only a matter of time now. He'll follow like a moth to a flame.
Let's set up a decoy Element Z reservoir for LeChomp to attack when he arrives. You keep him busy and I'll replace the microchips in the Titans... they should be out of juice by now. Let's get to it!
Collect {total} Engineers to help quickly build the decoy reservoir.
Use a Titan {total} times in battle, to scare LeChomp. Did he think you were helpless?
Use all the Element Z you just stole from LeChomp!
Pick your units wisely in the fight. Using Titans of your own will give you an edge.
It's time to take a nice big bite out of LeChomp's forces... and his confidence!
Well played, Commander! Our Titans are under our control again. That has to be one for the books!
You have {num} Titan Platings. You need {total}.

Ciddi misin?! Teröristler onları kapıda karşılayacağımızı mı sanıyor? Bir fikrim var! Onları un ufak edelim, sonra da ana kamplarını bulup yerle bir edelim! Zorlu arazilerden geçmemiz gerekecek! Meydan okumaya hazır mısın Komutan?
12 - 30 seviyesindeki oyuncular Dağ Avcı Uçağı ve Kuş Avcısı'nın I. sürümünü; 31 - 50 seviyesindekiler II. sürümünü; 51 ve üzeri seviyedekiler ise III. sürümünü kazanabilir.
Tehlikeli bir terör grubu gözünü İmparatorluğuna dikti. Hayatta kalmanın tek yolu savaşmak.

Komutan {player_name}, sınır güvenlik kuvvetlerimiz terörist faaliyet bildirdi: kendilerine 'Savaşla Demokrasi' diyen radikal kaçıklar. Aptallığa bak! Ne yazık ki aptallık çoğu zaman tehlikeli demektir.
5 adet Özel Harekât Behemot Topçusu kazandın!
5 adet Özel Harekât Ankit İnsansız Devriye Botu kazandın!
Sınırımız teröristlerin saldırısı altında! İyimserlikleri için hakkını vermek lazım. Kiminle uğraştıklarını onlara gösterelim!
Teröristleri kandırmak için {total} Sahte DBW Rozeti al
Sınırındaki teröristlere aşırı özgüvenin ne büyük bir aptallık olduğunu öğret!
Bunca yıllık hizmetimde kötü adamların bu kadar hızlı kaçtığını hiç görmedim... hem de kuyruklarını bacaklarının arasına sıkıştırarak. Şimdi ilerliyoruz.

DBW şimdilik geri çekildi. Sınırımıza yakın bir karakolları olduğunu duyuyoruz. Muhtemelen komşu Varkadyalılardan yardım istemeliyiz. Bu araziyi en iyi onlar bilir, hem önceki kralları da bu teröristler tarafından suikaste kurban gitmişti.
Yardım için göndermek üzere {total} Er Asker seç.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağın olduğundan emin ol.
Kazanma şansını artırmak için Güçlendirici kullan
Biz Varkadya'dan yardım isterken terörist karakoluna topyekûn bir saldırı başlatalım.
Düşmana karşı bir adım önde olma hissine alışabilirim. Kamplarına doğru ilerleyelim!
Yavaşla! Ziyaretçilere düşmanlığıyla bilinen bir kabile köyüne yaklaşıyoruz. Bu kabileler pek eğlenceli olmalarıyla tanınmaz. İçlerinden geçmek zorundayız.
{total} Uyuşturucu Mermi al. Onları öldürmek istemiyoruz, değil mi?
Yolculara pusu kurmak için kullandıkları Askerleri tuzağa düşür
En İyi Birimlerini seçmek erken zafer getirir.
Burada yerel bir eğlenceleri var. Adı 'Dövüşmek'.
Olumsuz önyargıları... yani ünlerini haklı çıkarmaya çalışan bir kabile köyü var. Artık bizim de ünümüzü haklı çıkarma zamanı.
İyi iş. Kazandık ama iyi savaştılar. Bakalım hayatta kalanları eğitebilecek miyiz.
Görünüş aldatıcıdır. Geçmek üzere olduğumuz o sakin, açık vadi terörist pusu timleriyle dolu olabilir. Son derece dikkatli ilerle!
Bize arkadan saldıran Pusu timini yok et.
Kazanma şansını artırmak için Güçlendirici kullan.
İleriye bak! Bizi bekleyen bir savaş var.
Hayatta Kalma Modunda {total} dalga tamamla. Hayatta kalma ipuçları için. Onlara ihtiyacımız var.
Bütün dalgaları tek seferde tamamlamak zorunda değilsin. Sonra dönüp yeniden deneyebilirsin.
Açık yol en tehlikeli yoldur. Pusu timlerine dikkat et.
Böyle vadiler yerine dağları tercih ederim. Aslında "Ölüm Vadisi" adı bize bir ipucu olabilirdi...
Bir terörist karakolu daha mı? Epey meşgul oldukları belli. Büyük birimlerle tüm gücümüzle saldırma zamanı.
Kazanma şansını artırmak için Güçlendirici kullan.
Her vuruşta ek enerji kazanmak için Yıldırım Birimlerini kullan!
Yok edilecek bir karakol daha. Bana mı öyle geliyor, yoksa bu adamlar gerçekten çok mu tahmin edilebilir?
Kuvvetlerimiz bir, teröristler sıfır. Dur, şu ilerideki ne? Onların Kampı!
Komutan {user, name}, onları tarihe gömerek tarih yazalım!
string.variation: Komutan {user,fem}, onları tarihe gömerek tarih yazalım!
Komutan {user,masc}, onları tarihe gömerek tarih yazalım!

string.original: Bu kaçıkların birim dediği İblislerin üzerine bomba yağdır
'Savaşla Demokrasi' terör örgütüne yeni bir meslek edinmek için iyi bir sebep ver!
Tebrikler Komutan {user,name}! Başardın. Savaşla Demokrasi'nin hayatta kalan üyeleri örgüt adlarını yeniden düşünmek için bolca zaman bulacak... hapiste!
string.variation: Tebrikler Komutan {user,fem}! Başardın. Savaşla Demokrasi'nin hayatta kalan üyeleri örgüt adlarını yeniden düşünmek için bolca zaman bulacak... hapiste!
Tebrikler Komutan {user,masc}! Başardın. Savaşla Demokrasi'nin hayatta kalan üyeleri örgüt adlarını yeniden düşünmek için bolca zaman bulacak... hapiste!

string.original: Bu dağlarda pek çok gözetleme noktası ve saklanacak bolca yer var. Onlarla savaşmak tam anlamıyla yokuş yukarı bir iş olacak.
Burada casuslar var. Onları yok et.
Her vuruşta ek enerji kazanmak için Yıldırım Birimlerini kullan!
Halledilecek daha çok casus var... dur, bunlar muhafız mı?
Zirvede konuşlanmış hava birimleri var! Ne yapacağını biliyorsun.
Kazanma şansını artırmak için Güçlendirici kullan.
Teröristleri yenmek kolay gibi geliyor. Bu dağlar çok daha zorlu.
İyi başlayan bir görev... neyse, daha yapacak çok işimiz var.
Pusuya düştük! Düşününce, buraya sürüş dersi almak için gelmedik zaten.
Kazanma şansını artırmak için Güçlendirici kullan.
Bu adamlar pek de örgütlü görünmüyor. Dur, şu bir terörist karakolu mu?
İleride bir terörist karakolu daha var. Yaklaştığımız konusunda uyarılmış olabilirler, bu yüzden gece saldırmalıyız.
Yaklaşan kuvvetleri açık kara savaşında karşıla
Bu teröristlerin kaç kampı var? Karakola dikkatle yaklaş. Güçlendirici kullanmak işe yarar.
Komutan, artık adrenalinle ilerliyoruz... adrenalin ve bolca özgüvenle.
Bu teröristler arasında gerçek dalgalar yaratalım. Onları tsunamiye boğalım... böyle bir deyim var, değil mi?
Kazanma şansını artırmak için Güçlendirici kullan.
Buralarda çok fazla karakol var. Ana terörist kampına neredeyse varmış olmalıyız.
Al sana DBW! O teröristler tam birer kaybeden. Aslında asıl kazananlar bizim askerlerimiz!
İyi haber şu Komutan {user, name}: teröristlerin ana kampındayız. Kötü haber ise çok güçlü bir kuvvetleri var.
string.variation: İyi haber şu Komutan {user,fem}: teröristlerin ana kampındayız. Kötü haber ise çok güçlü bir kuvvetleri var.
İyi haber şu Komutan {user,masc}: teröristlerin ana kampındayız. Kötü haber ise çok güçlü bir kuvvetleri var.

string.original: Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında ya insanlara saldırabilir ya da sana saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsin.
Yaralıları iyileştirmek için {total} Tıbbi Pamuk topla
Başardın! Bunu bir ara yeniden yapmak eğlenceli olurdu. Değil mi?
We must find a way to address this situation. If oil becomes a scarce resource, there's no telling what will become of this fragile peace we have fought so hard to maintain!
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the SpecOps Dragon Infantry and SpecOps Djinn Fighter; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
The inflation of fuel prices is causing all manner of disruptions in and outside of the Empire.
Commander, fuel prices are skyrocketing because of a shortage in supply. There's a great deal of anger among the citizens of your Empire. Things could go from bad to catastrophic in no time at all!

A picketing protest crowd has gathered outside the Parliament to protest the sudden and steep rise in price of petroleum. They're hostile and some are even wearing holstered guns. You must remove them forcefully.
Ask for {total} Bulletproof Shields for our police.
Earn {total} Red Hearts to prove your good intentions to your citizens.
Visit your Neighbors and help them out, or repel invasions in your Neighbors' Empires.
An enemy nation is trying to take advantage of the unrest. Fight them and win!
Pick your units wisely in the fight.
Protesters are picketing against petrol prices. Do your best to settle this unrest and handle this volatile crowd with caution!
The angry hordes have dispersed but I fear this is only the beginning of our problems.

Tempers are flying high! In a TV interview, your Foreign Secretary accused an enemy nation of driving up petrol prices by hoarding oil supplies! This puts us in a very dangerous position! Deploy troops in case of potential problems.
Assemble {total} Special Ops Ground Teams to station around the Empire.
Ask Friends for Special Ops Ground Teams.
Build {total} Units in anticipation of more trouble.
Units can be built in your Barracks, Hangar and Shipyard.
Earn {total} Black Hearts to gain a fearsome reputation.
Earn Black Hearts by successfully invading and collecting from invaded Neighbors, or repelling invasions in your Empire.
Your Foreign Secretary is to be a buffoon. He has no idea bout strategic diplomacy. Get ready for trouble!
That enemy nation doesn't forgive easily. Let's see what we can do to keep this situation from escalating.

Our Foreign Secretary was a fool to make that public accusation, but his facts might actually be right. I know how volatile the accused nation's leader can be so I've invited him here for peace talks. Let's do our best to set him at ease!
Complete {total} waves of Survival Mode, to keep your forces busy, behind the scenes.
You don't have to complete all the waves at one go. You can come back later and try again.
Harvest {total} Tomatoes to make dinner for the enemy leader. He may stay late.
Plant Tomatoes in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
Place {total} Soldiers at strategic points, to prevent trouble.
Placing Soldiers in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
You can't frown into a fruity drink with an umbrella in it. It just isn't possible. Do your best to settle this issue diplomatically.
Despite our best attempts, the talks resulted in a stalemate. That nation's leader is a stubborn one!
We need to appease the angry nation. Let's do all we can to bring this precarious situation under control. I suggest that we go into PR overdrive!
Gain {total} Energy by visiting Neighbors, as part of your PR drive.
Help each Neighbor 5 times to get 1 Energy.
Pillage {total} times, on the sly, to get resources for a possible war.
Invade your Neighbors and collect resources.
Build {total} Experimental Units to further strengthen your force.
Experimental Units can be built in the Experimental Barracks, Experimental Hangar and Experimental Shipyard.
The right PR can turn almost anything around. Really, it's just like magic! Go all out to appease the angry nation.
Good work, Commander! You managed to pull the foot out of your Foreign Secretary's mouth. Now let's see what more we can do about this oil crisis.

I don't see what other choice we have. We must make a large purchase of petroleum from the neighbor at the inflated rate. This will offset the dipping supply in our Empire. It will also seal a pact of peace with the neighbor we offended.
Draw up {total} Purchase Orders for the petroleum we're buying.
Repel {total} Invasions from Neighboring Empires, to gain further goodwill.
Visit your Friends' Empires to help repel invaders.
Deploy {total} Grunt Soldiers to your Neighbor's defense fleet as part of your peacemaking.
Placing Grunt Soldiers in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
These are desperate times. They call for equally desperate measures. You must pay a price for peace!
Our immediate supply crisis may be temporarily averted, but we need to find a more effective solution. We can't keep buying oil at these inflated rates!

Our economists have released information about the real reason for the price rise. A global oil rig workers strike is at the heart of the problem. Let's strike a deal with the Unions that the workers are part of.
Gather {total} Trade Union Leaders to meet with.
Ask Friends for Trade Union Leaders.
Use {total} Mind Control Strike Teams, to keep troublemakers at bay during the talks.
Deploy Strike Teams when repelling invasions on your Empire. Build them at the Strike Team HQ.
Build {total} Accuracy II Power-Ups, in case things end in battle, as they always do.
If you don't have the Power-Up Factory, you can build it. You will find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
Meet with the Unions to strike a deal. Trade Union Leaders are notoriously prickly. So don't pull a Foreign Secretary move on them!
Well now, the Unions seem happy with the deal we struck. You did good, Commander! This crisis should resolve itself in no time!

Rumors abound that one of your enemies is going to invade you to steal your petrol reserves. After all, everyone is suffering with the shortage. It would be wise to deploy your land, sea and air forces, just in case.
Ask Friends for Rumors. You can also add more Neighbors through the World Parliament.
Use {total} Experimental Healing abilities to keep your units fighting fit.
The Medivac Chopper, Hospital Ship and Army Ambulance offer these healing abilities. The 'Use Element Z' button below the battle stage activates this ability.
Deploy {total} Sea Units, just in case the rumors are true.
Placing Sea Units in your Empire is deployment. Sea Units are built in your Shipyard.
Little birdies have been whispering in my ear all day. It can't hurt to be careful. Prepare for war in case the rumors are true.
It's good to see you taking this seriously, Commander! Some of your officers don't pay much heed to rumors. But you know better than to disregard them.

It wasn't just a rumor after all! The enemy just tried to attack one of our fast-depleting oil reservoirs. Let's show them that we're not about to take this lying down! Just watch out for those fires. We must save our oil supplies, not burn through them!
Use {total} Power-Ups in battle to teach the enemy a good lesson.
Use Power-Ups in battle to fight more effectively. Power-Ups are won in Battle Blitz or Dominance victories or built in your Power-Up Factory.
Build {total} Strike Teams, in preparation for another invasion.
If you haven't built a Strike Team HQ, you can find it in your Inventory under the Buildings Tab.
Get {total} Liberty Bonds so you can expand and build more reservoirs.
You can get Liberty Bonds by fighting Campaign battles or asking Friends.
You can take these guys with ease, Commander. Throw them out on their behinds!
Nicely done! I doubt they'll bring their sticky fingers back here in a hurry!
I was wrong, Commander. This enemy is either really desperate or really stupid. They've attacked again! This time they're hitting one of our sea rigs. Get out there and save our supplies!
Ask for {total} Lifejackets in case things go bad while you're fighting at sea.
Repel {total} Invasions, to establish your boundaries.
Repel Invasions in your Empire by fighting or using Strike Teams.
Destroy {total} Units using Carriers, but don't hit the rig.
Carriers can be built in your Shipyard!
Honestly, how many poundings will it take for this enemy to get the picture? They are NOT getting our oil! Stop them!
You forced them to retreat again, but they could very well be rallying forces to attack again. Perhaps it's time for a different play...

This is stupid. Why are we waiting around for their next charge? Let's launch an attack on their Empire, just to keep them in their place! The little bullies need to know that the big fish aren't tolerating any more of this!
Ask for {total} Army Bugles to summon your troops to action.
Ask Friends for Army Bugles. You can also add more Neighbors through the World Parliament.
Win {total} Battle Blitz Fights, to warm up for the big battle.
You can fight up to 15 battles a day.
Destroy {total} Land Units when you fight the enemy.
Land Units can be destroyed in battles, including Survival Mode, World Domination and Battle Blitz.
As they say, it's time for an education! Teach them a lesson they won't forget.
I almost feel like we were disciplining a small child. But I think they learned their lesson. After all, we're all suffering from the same shortage...

Finally, some news on the street about the cause of this petroleum crisis! Oil rig workers have risen up in protest of their abysmal compensation. I know a way we can bring their strike to a quick end. Meet their demands... within reason, of course.
Ask for {total} Smiley Badges to keep them happy with their met demands.
Get {total} Dominance War Chests, as a reward for proving your dominance.
You'll get one War Chest with every Domination battle that you win.
Harvest {total} Red Onions. After all this drama, some hot soup would be nice.
Plant Red Onions in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
The word 'inflation' tastes so bad on my tongue. Let's do all we can to fix things so that I don't have to utter it again!
Excellent work! I'm glad this is finally over; I'm really not very good at scrimping on anything. Just ask my personal banker...

string.original: İyi gidiyorsun, Komutan. Ama önümüzde daha çok iş var. Önce daha fazla Top Topçusu üreterek başlayalım.
Krunsch son adasını bir deniz ablukasıyla koruyor, kendi Donanmamızı kurup onlara cepheden vurmalıyız.
Eminim o düşman Askerlerini daha hızlı devirmek istiyorsun. Bunun için Klasik Tank birebir.
Laboratuvardaki çocukların araştırmalarında ilerlemek için daha fazla madene ({rare}) ihtiyacı var. Ne yapacağını biliyorsun.
Düşman, bazı adalarımız arasında ikmal taşınmasını engellemek için abluka kurdu. Aptallar!
Scarlett önümüzde büyük savaşlar olduğunu haber verdi. Müttefiklerimiz tam şimdi işe yarayabilir.
Çocuklarımız bir Karanlık İttifak denizaltısını ele geçirmeyi başardı, ama onu adamıza getirmemiz gerekiyor.
Ele geçirdiğimiz denizaltıdan gelen bilgiye göre çiftliklerimizden biri Karanlık İttifak için silah saklıyor. Bir bak.
Keşif dronlarımızdan biri düşürüldü. Düşman bulmadan onu bulmalıyız.
En çok madalya almış pilotlarımızdan biri emekli oluyor. Krallara layık bir karşılamayı hak ediyor!
Bir karaborsa silah tüccarının Kuzgun'a silah sattığına dair istihbarat var. Onu durduralım.
Kuzgun fark etmeden bu silah tüccarını yakalayıp sorgulamalıyız.
Pazarda alıcı kılığına girersek kaçak silah tedarikçisini yakalayabiliriz.
Selam Patron! Adım McCann, ama bana Mac diyebilirsin. Hadi imparatorluğu yeniden kurmaya başlayalım.
İnsanların yaşayacak bir yere ihtiyacı var. Birkaç ev inşa edelim.
Daha gelişmiş birimler üretmek için Petrole ihtiyacımız olacak. Petrol üretim tesislerimizi yeniden kuralım.
Pazarda yakında kıtlık olacağına dair bir ihbar aldık. Garantiye almak için stok yapalım.
Bina yapmaya devam etmek için çok daha fazla keresteye ihtiyacımız olacak. Bir Kereste Fabrikası kursak nasıl olur?
Bugün Scarlett'ın doğum günü, onu Çilekli turtayla şaşırtmak istedim. Ne dersin, patron?
Karanlık İttifak'la baş etmek istiyorsak altyapımızı kurmaya başlasak iyi olur. Biraz daha kereste toplayarak başlayalım.
Scarlett Maden Ocakları konusunda tam isabet. Birkaçını kurup çalıştıralım!
Adamızda sadece şu madeni çıkarabiliyoruz: {rare}. Diğer maden türlerini toplamak için müttefiklerimizi ziyaret edip ticaret yapmalıyız.
Maden ve kaynak ticaretinin en iyi yolu Pazardır. Bir tane inşa edelim ve müttefiklerimize madenimizi ({rare}) sağlayalım!
Müttefiklerimiz fazla madenlerini ({nrare3}) veriyor. Onları ziyaret edip ellerinden almalıyız!
Müttefiklerimizin üretimi bir doğal afet yüzünden yavaşladı. Onlara yardım edelim.
Çocuklarım okul için bir bilim fuarı projesi hazırlıyor. Onlara biraz hammadde ile yardım etsek olur mu?
Pazarda bol miktarda maden ({nrare2}) olduğu haberi geldi. Kuzgun'dan önce hepsini kapmalıyız.
Çocuklar bu hafta sonu kütük oymacılığı yarışması yapmak istiyor ama önemli bir şey eksik: güzel kütükler!
Müttefiklerimizin bağışlamaya hazır fazla Madenleri var. Fikirlerini değiştirmeden işe dahil olalım derim!
Pazar uzmanları bir maden kıtlığı ({nrare4}) öngörüyor. Bakalım komşularımız biraz ayırabilir mi.
Çocuklar bu hafta sonu balkabağı fırlatma etkinliği yapmak istiyor. Ne dersin, patron? Biraz balkabağı fırlatalım mı?
Tamam Patron, hava kuvvetleri kuruyorsak çok daha fazla madene ({rare}) ihtiyacımız var.
Dikkat, Patron! Daha fazla gemi istiyorsan adamızda çıkarabileceğimizden daha fazla madene ({rare}) ihtiyacımız olacak. Diğer dört maden türü için komşularına güvenebilirsin.
Bana sorarsan Patron, bu ahmakta tanıdık bir şey var. Lastik eldivenler olmalı...
Bu konuda Scarlett'tan yanayım, Patron. Kuzgun'la eski usul bir silahlanma yarışındayız. Gaza basıp biraz maden toplayalım!
Tavsiyemi ister misin, Patron? Kuzgun'un eski Savunma Danışmanımızı neden tuttuğunu Scarlett çözsün. Sen ve ben imparatorluğumuzu ilerletmeye odaklanalım.
